claim: System for building agents that read the web, watch events and act; hackable IFTTT/Zapier on your own server
Sources and actions: scrape, RSS, IMAP, webhooks, MQTT, Slack, Telegram, Twilio, OpenAI-compatible APIs
Custom logic in JavaScript, Liquid or jq; publish feeds and JSON endpoints
Docker image ghcr.io/huginn/huginn runs all processes in one container; Compose recommended for production
Web process plus background worker, backed by MySQL or PostgreSQL
Single-process image runs each process in its own container
Managed Huginn hosting is offered by sponsors listed in doc/sponsors.md
Community packages for YunoHost and Unraid may lag behind releases
MIT licence (data/projects/huginn.json); Rails stack (Rake and bundle commands in README)
